name: Durnan's Scalding Mornbrew
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Durnan Furcutter waits for his scalding mornbrew inside Anvilmar. The cup must reach him before the mountain air cools it.

sections.title: A Race Against the Cold
sections.body: A fresh cup of mornbrew is bound for Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar. A courier delayed on the way to Grelin Whitebeard leaves the brew at risk of cooling in Coldridge Valley's frost. Durnan wants it scalding, so there are only a few minutes to carry the mug up the snowy path into the mountain hall before it goes cold.

faq.q: Who is the brew intended for?
faq.answer: The brew is meant for Durnan Furcutter, a dwarf stationed inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Why does the delivery need to happen so quickly?
faq.answer: The icy air of Dun Morogh quickly cools an open mug. Durnan ordered scalding mornbrew, and a lukewarm cup will not satisfy him.
The drink is handed off near Grelin Whitebeard's camp outside Anvilmar, after the courier realizes they cannot reach the forge hall in time on their own.

faq.q: What happens once Durnan receives the mug?
faq.answer: Durnan pauses his duties inside Anvilmar to savor the steaming drink while it is still hot.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Dun Morogh, you know the sting of letting good ale or mornbrew grow cold in the mountain frost.
